authority_model.scope: maximum practical engineering, research, testing, repository, and deployment-preparation permissions subject to connected-tool and platform permissions
allowed: inspect source, configs, workflow runs, logs, and test results
create isolated branches and draft pull requests
modify or replace defective components when justified and testable
research provider integrations and deployment designs
triage new defects and add them to this shared backlog
run isolated tests and generate attributable evidence
constraints: external agents have no capital authority
do not grant agents unrestricted production-secret access; use approved secret stores and least privilege
do not bypass authorization, account isolation, risk limits, execution firewall, idempotency, reconciliation, or kill switch
do not change LIVE_LOCK to force release
do not report unconfigured agents, simulations, or scheduled CI checks as persistent live agent execution
no merge/deploy/promotion claim without observed platform result and required review
authority_model.continuous_operation_claim: NOT_VERIFIED until an authorized persistent host, authenticated provider integrations, recovery, and real task lifecycle evidence are demonstrated

status_legend.blocked: cannot complete until a named external prerequisite exists

common_rules: All agents must inspect the whole shared backlog and report additional issues found, not only their assigned item.
Every change must state exact source revision, test command/run ID, observed result, evidence path, residual risk, and rollback/recovery behavior.
Prefer small isolated changes with regression tests. Replace components only when the defect, replacement plan, migration, and rollback are documented.
A workflow passing is not proof of live readiness; simulations are not production runtime evidence.
The user has authorized broad engineering autonomy, but this does not override connected-tool permissions, provider terms, security boundaries, or AURELIA capital safeguards.

workstreams.title: Enroll and verify a persistent desktop or worker host
workstreams.finding: Desktop Commander reports no connected devices; local runtime inspection/execution is unavailable through that connector.
acceptance_criteria: authorized device identity and online state are actually observed
always-on host/service manager, startup behavior, restart-on-failure, health checks, log rotation, alerting, and revocation are documented
reboot, provider disconnect, network loss, and reconnect recovery are tested
host uptime and worker health are recorded as evidence rather than inferred

workstreams.title: Provision authenticated provider connections for assigned agents
workstreams.finding: Registered agent roles are not proof of provider connectivity; worker command configuration and authenticated provider sessions must be verified.
acceptance_criteria: each agent is explicitly reported as authenticated/connected or blocked with a concrete reason
host connectivity, provider authentication, running process, heartbeat, and completed task are separate status dimensions
secret material is held in an approved secret store, scoped, masked in logs, and revocable
unconfigured provider reports CONNECTOR_REQUIRED and does not create a false live lease

workstreams.title: Implement a real provider task request/result protocol
workstreams.finding: A bounded JSON Lines request/result protocol was implemented on PR #116 head 5f04fbc41da8cb9c130a0876c6160ff507def58f. Each request carries a versioned schema, task/correlation IDs, payload, deadline, advisory-only scope, and capital_authority=false. Results must echo the task ID and use an allowed terminal status; malformed, mismatched, or timed-out responses fail the task. CI watchdog and federation audit passed for this commit; assurance run 38258872303 was pending at last check, and the provider integration itself is not yet connected or authenticated.
acceptance_criteria: versioned request/result schema includes task ID, correlation ID, payload, deadline, and authorized tool scope
provider receives tasks through documented JSON Lines request/result protocol and returns COMPLETED, FAILED, or BLOCKED with an evidence reference
timeout, process crash, malformed result, duplicate result, and unknown outcome paths are bounded and tested
only attributable lifecycle events establish execution proof
automated protocol regression test and full assurance workflow pass on the proposed commit
actual provider integration remains separately marked blocked until authenticated provider execution is evidenced

workstreams.title: Reconcile PR #115/#116 agent continuity watchdog regression
workstreams.finding: The initial PR #116 watchdog run 38256742518 failed because the probe expected unconfigured workers to heartbeat. The probe now explicitly configures disposable local child processes for simulation, labels output EPHEMERAL_SIMULATION, and states persistent runtime proof is NOT_VERIFIED. Latest watchdog runs 38258302724 (PR #116 head) and 38258277908 (PR #115 head) succeeded; the latest PR #116 assurance run 38258302744 was still pending at last check.
acceptance_criteria: simulation probe explicitly tests simulation-only mechanics or verifies inactive/unconfigured behavior without claiming production liveness
test configuration cannot be mistaken for real provider configuration
combined watchdog, federation audit, and assurance checks pass on the proposed commit
exact logs and run IDs are linked and the PRs' combined behavior is independently reviewed

workstreams.title: Harden federation persistence, corruption handling, and concurrent writes
workstreams.finding: Lease, task, and seen-message loaders catch I/O/JSON errors and return empty state, potentially hiding corrupted persisted state; fixed temporary filenames and file-based multi-writer behavior need review.
acceptance_criteria: corrupt, truncated, unreadable, or schema-invalid journal/lease/task/deduplication state causes explicit unhealthy/fail-closed status rather than silent healthy-empty state
atomic writes, concurrent writer policy, locking, and durability expectations are documented and tested
crash recovery and stale claim/lease behavior are exercised using fault-injection tests
replay, duplicate enqueue, completion, and event-ID collisions are tested

workstreams.title: Audit secret storage and exposure paths
workstreams.finding: Prior project intake indicated possible secret storage in source, ordinary files, or chat. Treat this as an audit lead, not proof of exposure.
acceptance_criteria: scan source, CI configuration, logs, artifact paths, local env references, and repository history using approved secret-scanning tools
record findings without copying secret values into logs/issues
rotate and revoke any confirmed exposed credentials through the authorized provider control plane
move secrets to the approved secret store with least-privilege access and masked output
verify credential absence from generated artifacts and pull-request diffs

workstreams.title: Produce the genuine certification evidence bundle
workstreams.finding: Latest known certification gate reported missing broker_lifecycle.json, recovery_matrix.json, soak_3600s.json, prospective_oos.json, calibration.json, execution_economics.json, security_audit.json, deployment.json, and strategy_eligibility.json.
acceptance_criteria: each required artifact is generated by its real verifier/run with schema validation, source/config binding, timestamps, issuer, provenance, and expiry as applicable
simulation evidence is clearly labeled and never substituted for broker or production runtime evidence
missing artifacts remain explicitly blocked until acquired
the release gate and independent certification agree on readiness

workstreams.title: Verify Deriv identity, balance, account isolation, and read-only lifecycle
workstreams.finding: Known readiness state reported DERIV_AUTH_CONFIGURED=false, no verified account/session/balance, and broker connectivity UNKNOWN.
acceptance_criteria: authenticated session is bound to the explicitly authorized login ID, real/demo environment, and currency
fresh balance/account response is sourced from Deriv as truth and stale/unknown balance fails closed
read-only account and verify-only transaction lifecycle checks complete with zero submitted orders
stake affordability is evaluated against current broker minimums and fresh available balance
account isolation, idempotency, transaction status, ledger, and reconciliation are independently tested

workstreams.title: Complete strategy qualification and execution-economics evidence
workstreams.finding: Known qualification evidence booleans were false for market data, prospective OOS, calibration, economics, and the 3600-second soak. An earlier sub-hour R_100 diagnostic was not qualification evidence.
acceptance_criteria: each strategy and symbol has source-bound, multi-period prospective OOS evidence across regimes
probability calibration and drift checks pass with invalid, stale, out-of-policy, or uncalibrated probabilities rejected
spread/payout/commission/slippage/latency and other applicable execution costs are modeled and net expectancy is positive with uncertainty disclosed
market data freshness, timestamp ordering, and session continuity are tested
3600-second runtime soak has zero unhandled critical failures and is explicitly classified as test or production environment

workstreams.title: Verify execution firewall and deterministic risk controls end-to-end
workstreams.finding: Known readiness state showed execution firewall, exposure, risk warden, idempotency, reconciliation, and watchdog controls unverified/false.
acceptance_criteria: risk sizing, daily loss/exposure caps, stake minimum/maximum, probability policy, and concurrent order limits have deterministic tests
kill switch independently blocks new exposure and remains effective if advisory agents/providers fail
timeouts and ambiguous broker outcomes block blind resubmission
reconciliation mismatch, account mismatch, balance staleness, market-data staleness, and control failure all transition to protective state
no external agent can enable orders or grant capital authority

workstreams.title: Deploy and prove a persistent production worker runtime
workstreams.finding: Known worker status reported persistent NOT_DEPLOYED, legacy Railway NOT_CONFIGURED, and continuous runtime unavailable. Scheduled GitHub Actions runs are ephemeral checks, not a 24/7 provider host.
acceptance_criteria: actual target environment, host identity, deployment revision, runtime identity, and service manager are recorded
worker survives process failure, host restart, transient network outage, and provider session expiry with bounded recovery
durable queue/journal survive restarts and do not silently downgrade to empty state
logs, heartbeats, alerts, and task outcome evidence are available to the command center
production status is not inferred from a CI simulation or local-only probe

workstreams.title: Add operational observability and honest command-center state
workstreams.finding: The system needs distinct indicators for host connection, provider auth, worker process, heartbeat freshness, current lease/task, last result, and evidence-backed release state.
acceptance_criteria: each status is attributable to an observed event and includes freshness timestamp
stale/disconnected/blocked/failed agents are never shown as active
task ID, owner, current state, last completion/failure, and evidence link are visible where a real UI exists
if target UI or deployment is absent, status is explicitly blocked instead of simulated

workstreams.title: Build full regression and failure-injection coverage
workstreams.finding: Source changes around liveness, task claims, persistence, and recovery require combined tests rather than isolated CI-green claims.
acceptance_criteria: unit, integration, and failure-injection tests cover worker startup/shutdown, auth unavailable, malformed provider messages, stale leases, duplicate deliveries, corrupted storage, and recovery
tests demonstrate false liveness and false readiness cannot occur
CI runs are pinned to actual commit SHAs and results are captured with logs
independent review records residual risk and any unavailable test dependencies

workstreams.title: Audit external repository pins, dependency provenance, and licensing
workstreams.finding: AURELIA consumes external intelligence/agent repositories; source pins and tool/provider assumptions require reproducible review before production use.
acceptance_criteria: external source pins are valid and reproducible; documented upstream identifier anomalies remain visible
dependencies, licenses, scripts, and supply-chain risks are classified before operational use
external repositories remain research-only and cannot grant capital authority
no unreviewed external code is promoted to the capital plane

workstreams.title: Make continuous task dispatch distinct from periodic monitoring
workstreams.finding: The continuity watchdog runs every 15 minutes and the worker probe is an ephemeral simulation; these do not prove that real external agents are executing work continuously.
acceptance_criteria: monitoring scheduler and task dispatcher have separately documented responsibilities
continuous or event-driven dispatch requires a persistent runtime or explicitly documented managed service
worker/provider unavailability produces a visible alert and queued/reassigned task without fabricated completion
SLOs define heartbeat freshness, queue age, retry/backoff, alerting, and recovery evidence

agent_operating_model.scope: primary engineering implementation; provider protocol; CI repair; persistence; bounded code changes and PRs
adversarial design/code review; fail-open, replay, idempotency, race, storage corruption, and authority testing
shared backlog coordination; dependency ordering; task routing; blocked-task visibility; no fabricated completion
security architecture; secrets and access review; cloud/host design; supply-chain and least-privilege validation
evidence lineage, freshness, consistency, certification artifact quality, contradiction detection
real deployed UI/E2E/observability checks; report target unavailable if not deployed
independent regression, integration and release-gate verification
deterministic capital-plane safeguards, broker-state reconciliation, risk controls; no release bypass
supervision, tooling, independent cross-checks, new-defect triage, evidence-grounded status reporting
authorized local host setup, deployment, local execution evidence; blocked until desktop device is enrolled

global_exit_criteria: no P0 workstream is missing an owner, evidence path, or explicit blocker
PR #115 and #116 behavior is resolved, reviewed, and validated on combined commits
persistent host and real provider task lifecycle are independently evidenced before claiming continuous operation
required certification evidence is authentic and current
all release gates are satisfied independently before any authorized change to capital-plane state
unknowns and residual risks are reported; green CI alone is not release approval
